title: International Civil Aviation Organization
definition: The International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations established by the Chicago Convention of 1944 to manage the administration and governance of the Convention on International Civil Aviation (Chicago Convention).
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Civil Services Examination under GS Paper II (International Organizations, UN agencies) and GS Paper III (Infrastructure: Aviation sector, External Sector, Global Governance). Tests knowledge of specialized UN bodies, international treaties, and aviation safety standards.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of International Civil Aviation Organization.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core foundational concepts of International Relations and UN Specialized Agencies
